title: SuperframeNFT
tagline: Project using SuperChains with OPSTACK, forked locally with op-node and op-geth. NFTs can be minted on any superchain by paying on BASE chain via OwlProtocol. Creators verified with WORLDID Authentication, mints on Frames, USDC set by creator.
description: This project leverages SuperChains with OPSTACK, running locally on op-node and op-geth. It integrates a custom network where NFTs can be minted on any superchain by paying on the BASE chain. The mint price is set by the creator in USDC. Before minting, creators are verified using WORLDID Authentication, with mints displayed on Frames.
how_its_made:
This project utilizes Owl Protocol to set up a gasless way to mint NFTs on any chain by paying in USDC on the BASE chain. After payment, the TokenID (auto-incremental) is displayed, along with a link to the Blockscout explorer (https://base.blockscout.com). Creators are verified using WORLDID Authentication, and their status is saved as "verified" in the database.

NFTs are minted using Frames, tied to a wallet address on the Farcaster protocol. This allows creators to share their live NFT mints on Farcaster, with the NFTs existing on any chain, while payments are made in USDC on the BASE chain, ensuring a smooth user experience.
